name: kotonoha
_workspaces_omitted: Intentionally NOT declaring `workspaces`. The SPA's `web/package.json` runs Vite via a direct binary path (`node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js`) to dodge a bun-on-Windows bug where `bun run vite` silently swallows the dev server's stdout. That direct path requires Vite to live under `web/node_modules/`, which only happens if bun installs locally there — workspace mode would hoist it to the repo root and break the build.
_comment: The SPA lives under the kotonoha-server crate so `cargo publish` can bake the built dist/ into the binary via rust-embed. Fresh-clone install is intentionally two-step (run `bun install` from inside `backend/crates/kotonoha-server/web/`, or use `cargo make frontend-dev` which cd's there for you). Tried postinstall and `bun install && bun run ...` chains — both hang indefinitely on Windows because bun-from-inside-bun shares a parent lock that never releases. Until that upstream bug clears, the boring documented two-step is the only thing that doesn't deadlock.
